newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania shilling strengthens on dollar, pound.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania shilling strengthens on dollar, pound.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling strengthened on Thursday against the dollar and pound sterling, partly because of an inflow of investment from neighbouring Kenya.
The shilling exchanged at a mean commerical rate to the dollar of 618.750 on Thursday from 619.245 on Wednesday and 980.8456 to the pound sterling from 984.1692 on Wednesday.

Financial analysts say hard currency has been flowing into Tanzania this month, much of it capital leaving Kenya since the Kenyan shilling started sliding against the dollar after the International Monetary Fund halted a key loan package.
